description_en: Mutes a specific user in a room
description_zh: 调用BanComment接口，实现对房间内某特定用户实施禁言操作
kebab_example: aliyun imp ban-comment --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE350000T95F --user-id as0000hs --ban-comment-user er0000h --region cn-hangzhou
name: BanComment

parameters.help_en: The application ID. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when you call the CreateRoom operation
parameters.help_zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the mute operation
parameters.help_zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了禁言操作
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the user to be muted
parameters.name: ban_comment_user

parameters.help_en:
The mute duration. Unit: seconds.

If this parameter is not specified, the default mute duration is 30 seconds.

A value of 0 indicates a permanent mute.

The maximum value cannot exceed 24 hours. If the value exceeds 24 hours, it is automatically set to 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
禁言时长，单位：秒。

如果不填写该字段，默认禁言30秒。

传0表示永久禁言。

最大值不得超过24小时，如果超过，会被限制为24小时
parameters.name: ban_comment_time

Result.description_en: The result of the mute operation. A value of true indicates that the user is muted. A value of false indicates that the mute operation failed
Result.description_zh: 获取禁言操作调用结果，true代表禁言成功，false代表禁言失败
